notes: نبئت (passive: I was told) names no transmitter: unnamed at that point (rule 8)
the names after the last ح (from يحيى بن زكريا to عمر) are written once and belong to both branches (rule 3); where the first branch joins is read from the text's order
وقال عمرو إن رسول الله ... is a wording variant: left out
